notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» names no one: bare relation (rule 7); «علي بن الحسين» and «محمد بن الحسن» are joined by «جَمِيعاً» and meet at the next name
the editor's brackets «[عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ]» and «[مَالِكٍ]» are variant readings, not part of the printed names; surfaces keep the printed names without them
the Imam after «عَنْ» is a narrator (ruling 2); «(ع)» is left out
